comparison.objective: Twist a rubber stopper onto a glass tube while supporting the tube close to the work.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual close support, axial insertion, twisting under friction, and force/damage control.
comparison.success_condition: Stopper reaches at least 12 mm depth and is released; excessive unsupported travel/rotation or any glass damage fails.
comparison.reason: Supported interference insertion of one component is not selective granular passage, even though both involve orientation and force control. The multiple revisions fully specify the tested outcome.
